highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.2 refreshes its m151 native baseline without changing managed APIs.
highlights_body: The HarfBuzzSharp package uses the m151 revision bucket; its native HarfBuzz version remains 14.2.1.

bullets.detail: Incorporates the same-milestone Chrome M151 servicing sync while retaining the existing C API, managed wrappers, and generated bindings.
